description: This file manages configuration reading, writing, and validation for the OpenClaw application on macOS. It provides functions to load and save configuration dictionaries, handle remote gateway URLs, check metadata, and audit configuration health. It also tracks suspicious changes and maintains logs for configuration state and anomalies.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the configuration URL from OpenClawPaths.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the application's state directory.

methods.name: defaultWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Returns the default workspace URL for the application.

methods.name: loadDict
methods.description: Loads the configuration as a dictionary, parsing JSON data from the config file.

methods.name: saveDict
methods.description: Saves the given dictionary as the configuration file, with auditing and suspicion checks.

methods.name: loadGatewayDict
methods.description: Loads and returns the 'gateway' subsection of the configuration.

methods.name: updateGatewayDict
methods.description: Mutates the 'gateway' subsection of the configuration and saves it.

methods.name: browserControlEnabled
methods.description: Checks if browser control is enabled in the config.

methods.name: setBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables browser control in the configuration.

methods.name: agentWorkspace
methods.description: Retrieves the agent workspace setting.

methods.name: setAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Sets the agent workspace setting.

methods.name: gatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the remote gateway password from the configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway port from the configuration.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort
methods.description: Retrieves the port from the remote gateway URL if available.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort(matchingHost:)
methods.description: Retrieves the port from the remote gateway URL if it matches a specific SSH host.

methods.name: setRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Sets the remote gateway URL in the configuration based on host and port.

methods.name: clearRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Removes the remote gateway URL from the configuration.

methods.name: hostKey
methods.description: Generates a consistent key for a host, normalized and lowercased.

methods.name: parseConfigData
methods.description: Parses raw JSON data into a dictionary, with support for JSON5.

methods.name: stampMeta
methods.description: Adds or updates meta information like version and timestamp.

methods.name: hasMeta
methods.description: Checks if the configuration dictionary contains meta information.

methods.name: gatewayMode
methods.description: Retrieves the gateway mode string from configuration.

methods.name: configWriteSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Determines reasons why a configuration write might be suspicious based on size and metadata differences.

methods.name: configAuditLogURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the configuration audit log.

methods.name: configHealthStateURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the configuration health state file.

methods.name: readConfigHealthState
methods.description: Reads and returns the current configuration health state.

methods.name: writeConfigHealthState
methods.description: Writes the provided state to the configuration health status file.

methods.name: configHealthEntry
methods.description: Retrieves health info for a specific config path from stored state.

methods.name: setConfigHealthEntry
methods.description: Updates health info for a config path in the state.

methods.name: isUpdateChannelOnlyRoot
methods.description: Checks if the configuration root indicates an update channel only.

methods.name: fileTimestampMs
methods.description: Converts a file attribute date to milliseconds timestamp.

methods.name: fileAttributeInt
methods.description: Extracts an integer from a file attribute value.

methods.name: fileSystemNumber
methods.description: Converts a file system number attribute to a string.

methods.name: posixMode
methods.description: Extracts POSIX permission mode as an integer.

methods.name: configFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint hash and metadata summary of a config file.

methods.name: sameFingerprint
methods.description: Compares two fingerprints to determine if they are identical.

methods.name: observeSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Determines reasons why config file changes might be suspicious.

methods.name: readConfigFingerprint
methods.description: Reads and fingerprints a config file at a given URL.

methods.name: configTimestampToken
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string into a filename-friendly token.

methods.name: persistClobberedSnapshot
methods.description: Saves a backup snapshot of a configuration data if necessary.

methods.name: observeConfigRead
methods.description: Observes and audits a configuration read, checking for anomalies and logging.

methods.name: appendConfigWriteAudit
methods.description: Appends a write event to the configuration audit log.

methods.name: appendConfigObserveAudit
methods.description: Appends a read anomaly event to the audit log.
